name: JSON:API Role Access
description: Provides feature to give or restrict access to JSON:API resources.
project_description:
The Jsonapi Role Access module allows you to manage access of jsonapi resources based on user role. It provides a simple setting form from where you can restrict or allow a user role to access jsonapi resource. For example, you can restrict anonymous user to access jsonapi resources or you can allow only authenticated user(or any role) to access jsonapi resources.

 Use Jsonapi Role Access to restrict or allow access of jsonapi resources to any user role.

 Back to top 

 Installation 
 
 Install the JSON:API module. 
 Install the Jsonapi Role Access module. 
 Visit /admin/config/jsonapi-role-access/settings to set access control. 
 If it doesn't reflect after saving settings form, try clearing routing cache. 
 
 Back to top 

 Installation Via Composer 
 
 composer require drupal/jsonapi_role_access
